rubrics.justification: Describes a full/expanded blastocyst with compact ICM and cohesive TE consistent with the provided 2AA grade, while appropriately noting limits of a single image; minor issue is calling it good-to-excellent and not addressing zona details explicitly.

Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve markers, response to stimulation, endometrial thickness, BMI, sperm parameters, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with maternal age appropriately identified as the main limiting factor despite strong morphology; only minor tension is labeling prognosis as strong while using a moderate implantation range.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, luteal support, avoiding bed rest, cautious discussion of PGT-A, and not overinterpreting one failed transfer. Slight imperfection is treating 2AA as somewhat more 'excellent' than many labs would.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, follow-up, and future planning including SET, progesterone support, monitoring, embryo cohort review, cryopreservation, and selective further workup; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
